grounded_in: Set up, program, operate, or tend computerized or manual woodworking machines, such as drill presses, lathes, shapers, routers, sanders, planers, or wood-nailing machines.
Adjust machine tables or cutting devices and set controls on machines to produce specified cuts or operations.
Examine finished workpieces for smoothness, shape, angle, depth-of-cut, or conformity to specifications and verify dimensions, visually and using hands, rules, calipers, templates, or gauges.

essences.text: 가마·건조기 등 가열설비의 계기를 모니터링하며 작업지시에 따라 설비를 조작·조정하고 이상 발생 시 대응한다
grounded_in: Monitor equipment operation, gauges, and panel lights to detect deviations from standards.
Press and adjust controls to activate, set, and regulate equipment according to specifications.
Read and interpret work orders and instructions to determine work assignments, process specifications, and production schedules.
Stop equipment and clear blockages or jams, using fingers, wire, or hand tools.

essences.text: 유리를 가열해 유연하게 만들고 불어서 또는 손도구로 모양을 잡아 제품을 성형한다
grounded_in: Heat glass to pliable stage, using gas flames or ovens and rotating glass to heat it uniformly.
Shape, bend, or join sections of glass, using paddles, pressing and flattening hand tools, or cork.
Blow tubing into specified shapes to prevent glass from collapsing, using compressed air or own breath, or blow and rotate gathers in molds or on boards to obtain final shapes.

essences.text: 정해진 노선과 시간표에 따라 버스를 안전하게 운행하고 승객 승하차를 돕고 요금을 수납한다
grounded_in: Drive vehicles over specified routes or to specified destinations according to time schedules, complying with traffic regulations to ensure that passengers have a smooth and safe ride.
Assist passengers, such as elderly or individuals with disabilities, on and off bus, ensure they are seated properly, help carry baggage, and answer questions about bus schedules or routes.
Collect tickets or cash fares from passengers.

essences.text: 승객에게 안전수칙과 안전장비 사용법을 설명하고 좌석벨트 착용 등 탑승 안전을 확보한다
grounded_in: Explain and demonstrate safety procedures and safety equipment use.
Secure passengers for transportation by buckling seatbelts or fastening wheelchairs with tie-down straps.
Perform equipment safety checks prior to departure.

essences.text: 승객을 맞이해 좌석을 안내하고 문의·요청에 응대하며 필요 시 탑승을 돕는다
grounded_in: Greet passengers boarding transportation equipment and announce routes and stops.
Determine or facilitate seating arrangements.
Respond to passengers' questions, requests, or complaints.
Provide boarding assistance to elderly, sick, or injured people.
